description: Report codebase changes since the last sync so VibeMap can flag spec drift. Workflow: 1) call vibemap_get_code_map and read anchor.commitSha; 2) run `git diff --name-only <commitSha>..HEAD` (plus untracked files from `git status --porcelain`); 3) call this tool with the changed paths and your current HEAD sha. The response lists affected map units and features — update the stale specs with vibemap_update_feature / vibemap_update_user_story / vibemap_update_acceptance_criterion (all changeset-audited). The drift report stays on the project until the flagged items are resolved or dismissed in VibeMap; re-submitting the code map does not clear it. While you are building a ticket, send spec changes through vibemap_propose_spec_change rather than editing the spec.

diffExcerpt.description: Optional excerpt of the diff (max 20000 chars), shown to the project owner beside the affected specs

headSha.description: Current HEAD commit sha (git rev-parse HEAD)

name: vibemap_sync_changes
